# A media changer session through SG_IO on /dev/sg4, written by hand from
# SMC-3 (READ ELEMENT STATUS, MOVE MEDIUM) and SPC fixed sense data.
#
# The library: transport 0x0000, drives 0x0100 and 0x0101, one
# import/export element 0x0200, slots 0x0400 to 0x0403.
#
# READ ELEMENT STATUS: VOLTAG, all element types, from address 0, up to
# 0xffff elements, allocation length 0x010000. 456 bytes come back.
sg_io b8 10 00 00 ff ff 00 01 00 00 00 00 from 65536 -> status=0 resid=65080
# Element status data header: first address 0, 8 elements, 0x1c0 bytes.
data 0000 0008 00 0001c0
# Medium transport page: type 1, PVOLTAG, descriptors of 0x34 bytes.
data 01 80 0034 00 000034
data 0000 00 00 00 00 000000 00 0000 spaces:32 zeros:4 zeros:4
# Data transfer page: drive 0x0100 full (ACCESS and FULL), its cartridge
# from slot 0x0401 (SVALID); drive 0x0101 empty.
data 04 80 0034 00 000068
data 0100 09 00 00 00 000000 80 0401 "E01002L5" spaces:24 zeros:4 zeros:4
data 0101 08 00 00 00 000000 00 0000 spaces:32 zeros:4 zeros:4
# Import/export page: one empty station.
data 03 80 0034 00 000034
data 0200 00 00 00 00 000000 00 0000 spaces:32 zeros:4 zeros:4
# Storage page: four slots, two full.
data 02 80 0034 00 0000d0
data 0400 09 00 00 00 000000 00 0000 "E01001L5" spaces:24 zeros:4 zeros:4
data 0401 08 00 00 00 000000 00 0000 spaces:32 zeros:4 zeros:4
data 0402 09 00 00 00 000000 00 0000 "E01003L5" spaces:24 zeros:4 zeros:4
data 0403 08 00 00 00 000000 00 0000 spaces:32 zeros:4 zeros:4

# MOVE MEDIUM with transport 0: slot 0x0400 to drive 0x0101.
sg_io a5 00 00 00 04 00 01 01 00 00 00 00 none 0 -> status=0

# From an empty slot: CHECK CONDITION, ILLEGAL REQUEST, 3B/0E (medium
# source element empty), fixed-format sense.
sg_io a5 00 00 00 04 01 01 00 00 00 00 00 none 0 -> status=2 sense=700005000000000a000000003b0e0000

# Into a full drive: 3B/0D (medium destination element full).
sg_io a5 00 00 00 04 02 01 00 00 00 00 00 none 0 -> status=2 sense=700005000000000a000000003b0d0000

# Out of a drive still holding its tape: 53/02 (medium removal
# prevented), descriptor-format sense this time.
sg_io a5 00 00 00 01 00 04 01 00 00 00 00 none 0 -> status=2 sense=7205530200000000

# An adapter failure: DID_TIME_OUT (host status 3).
sg_io a5 00 00 00 04 03 02 00 00 00 00 00 none 0 -> status=0 host=3
